message.content: {"summary": "Test the rearview camera under reverse to reproduce the reported distortion and document the recall-related camera fault.", "rationale": "The narrative reports a distorted rearview camera image while reversing on a 2015 Lincoln MKC. NHTSA recall 25V270000 covers a loose or damaged rearview camera printed circuit board terminal header connector that can cause a blank or distorted image, and recall 25V572000 covers distorted, inverted, or blank rearview camera images in reverse. The dealer found no failure and the recall repair part was unavailable.
